races.name: Every Race Live On Racing TV Nursery
races.verdict: It could be worth chancing NOTIMETOTAKEOFF, who looks on a decent mark for his nursery bow and has the assistance of Rossa Ryan. King of Persia and Golden Oasis are feared most.

runners.note: Showed the benefit of his initial outing when third in 1m novice at Salisbury last month but wasn't in same form at Bath last time. Tried in headgear for handicap debut.
Just modest form in a trio of starts thus far, latest when fourth of 10 in novice at Southwell (7f) 10 days ago. Improvement required on handicap debut.
Got off the mark in 7f maiden at Chepstow in July and returned to form when good third of 13 in nursery at Brighton (1m, good, 16/1) 15 days ago. Races off same mark here and is not taken lightly.
Thrice-raced maiden who got back on track when sixth of 11 in novice at Windsor (6f, firm) in June. Upped in trip for handicap debut and his opening mark demands improvement.
Well held at Southwell latest but had posted fair third at Kempton (1m) previously and looks fairly treated on handicap debut here.
Posted good fourth of 13 on nursery debut at Brighton (1m, good) 15 days ago, slowly away. Cheekpieces now added and ought to give another good account.
Ran poorly at Wolverhampton last time but had found some improvement at Salisbury previously and may do better now returned to turf for handicap bow.

Standout effort when 7 lengths third at York (7f) second time up. That form is looking increasingly flimsy besides the winner and he has run poorly twice since. Headgear reached for having been gelded ahead of this.
Much improved when winning 9-runner nursery at Redcar (1m, good to soft) 20 days ago, well positioned. 4 lb rise fair and is one for the shortlist.
Back on the up when narrowly taking 10-runner nursery (14/1) at Newcastle (7f) 11 days ago. Remains feasibly treated and could be a player here.

races.name: William Hill Challenge Series 3-Y-O Hurdle
races.verdict: DANNY POWER looked a good prospect when making an impressive start at Listowel last month and can defy a penalty before having his sights raised. Contador is an interesting recruit from France for Gordon Elliott and could be the danger, ahead of Sea of Dubka, who took to hurdling well at Killarney for all she was a fortunate winner.

runners.note: Fair on the Flat and immediately ran to a similar level over hurdles as he made a successful start at Ballinrobe (2¼m) last month, still plenty to do out wide entering straight but staying on well to lead close home. Sho

From a good family and having been well backed, looked an above-average juvenile as he made a winning start in well-run 2m Listowel hurdle last month, drawing clear impressively. Useful prospect and can defy a penalty.

Runner-up on second of 2 starts in France earlier this year and picked up for 120,000 gns from Juddmonte. No surprise to see him make an impact first time up in this sphere for new yard (won this race in 2020 with subseq

Half-brother to several Flat winners, including the smart middle-distance performer Armande. Down the field in Leopardstown maiden and Listowel hurdle (beaten 26¼ lengths by Danny Power). Hard to fancy.
Twice-raced fair maiden on the Flat for this yard. Should be clued up for his first go over hurdles and worth a look.
Well beaten on debut in Navan maiden in March and not seen since. Some hope for him in this sphere on breeding (from the family of useful hurdler Royal Eagle).
Modest maiden on the level, well beaten in 2 runs for this yard this year 6 months apart. Good Flat pedigree but difficult to recommend on hurdles debut.

Opened her account in 13f Down Royal handicap in July and fortunate to supplement that success at the first time of asking in this sphere at Killarney 8 weeks ago (left clear last), albeit she took to the job. Should go
From a good jumping family but little impact in Listowel hurdle (behind Danny Power) and Bellewstown maiden 10 days apart last month.

races.name: Betting.Bet Free Racing Tips Mares' 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: BLUE TOPAZ sets the standard on her third at Sedgefield last month and remains low mileage. She can take the opener. Miss Denver looks the obvious danger.

runners.note: Point winner who was successful on second outing in bumpers at Sedgefield last season and showed first form over obstacles when third of 7 in novice hurdle (50/1) at same course 29 days ago. Leading claims.

Proved consistent over fences this summer, latest when creditable second of 5 in handicap chase at Newton Abbot (2m, good) 36 days ago, albeit no match for winner. Posted good third at same course when last seen in this
Is bred more for stamina than speed and shaped in kind in a couple of bumpers this summer. Likely best watched on hurdles debut.
Kalanisi mare. Dam 2m-2½m hurdle/chase winner, also 1¼m-2m winner on Flat. Market should prove best guide to claims on NH debut.
Showed more than on hurdles debut when last of 5 in novice at Huntingdon (2½m, good to firm, 80/1) 7 days ago. Drop back in trip is not ideal, though.

races.name: British EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict: ROMOTOSO was a disappointing favourite at Southwell last time but a return to turf and a longer trip can see her in a better light. She gets the nod. Tradittion and Lady Foxtrot can also make their presence felt.

runners.note: Belied market weakness to make a winning start in 13-runner novice at Carlisle (6f, good to soft) last month. Well below that form at Goodwood since but must enter calculations here.
Foaled March 21. Ubettabelieveit filly. Half-sister to 5f winner Henery Hawk. Dam Belgian 7f winner. Yard without a juvenile winner this year.
Just modest form in a couple of starts so far, latest when sixth of 13 in maiden at Beverley (5f, good) 27 days ago, met some trouble. Probably one for nurseries.
Foaled February 25. Time Test filly. Half-sister to useful 7f winner Maywake. Dam maiden. Worth a look in the market on debut.
Foaled April 22. Masar filly. Dam, 1½m winner, half-sister to very smart 5f/6f winner (including Prix de l'Abbaye) Total Gallery. Likely a longer-term prospect.
Quirky filly who finished runner-up in her first 2 nursery starts but hasn't been in the same form more recently. Others more convincing.
Foaled January 19. 30,000 gns yearling, Inns of Court filly. Half-sister to several winners, including useful 7f winner Dutch Treat and Saudi Arabian 1m winner Barud. One to note on debut.
Disappointed at Newcastle latest but had been steadily progressive prior to that, including when fair second of 13 at Carlisle (6f) last month. One of likelier contenders.
Offered more than on debut when fourth of 7 in maiden at Bath (5f, good to soft) 30 days ago. Claims if building on that.
Foaled February 11. Lope Y Fernandez filly. Dam 6f winner. Yard boasts a fine record with their juvenile runners on turf this season.
Built on debut effort when third at Wetherby in June and looked a little rusty, back from 4 months off, when sixth of 9 in maiden at Wolverhampton (5f) 11 days ago, slowly away. Respected.
Disappointed over minimum trip at Southwell latest but finished placed on all 3 starts previously, including when close second of 14 at Windsor (6f) last month. Shortlist material.

races.name: Gents Night Saturday 24th October Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: LIMERICK LEADER hasn't looked back since joining Nick Scholfield and is fancied to defy a 4 lb rise and bag win number 4 for the yard here.

runners.note: Thriving for his new yard this season, and he gained a third win in 3-runner handicap chase at Newton Abbot (3¼m, good) 15 days ago. Up another 4 lb but this looks another good opportunity.

Has enjoyed a fine summer sent chasing, scoring twice over 23f at Worcester (latest after a breathing operation). Caught too far back when a running-on fourth of 7 at Uttoxeter (3m) last time. Can go very well again.

Got off the mark at Doncaster (3m) in February. Has run poorly both starts since, off 6 months before last of 6 in handicap chase at Worcester (23f, good) last month. Sketchy jumper. Cheekpieces go on for first time.

races.name: William Hill Challenge Series Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: ZUZUKEL went mightily close to opening his account here last season so Tony Martin's 6-y-o gets the tentative vote to go one better on return over Pavilion End, who has been in good order on the level and looks a potential improver now sent down the handicap route. Chantilly Wings and Houndsworth can fight out minor honours.

runners.note: Lightly raced and little impact since 2024/25, again well below his best at Clonmel back in May. Hard to fancy on return.

Fairly useful on Flat and can have his latest Dundalk effort overlooked having been struck into. Makes handicap hurdle debut and one to keep an eye on, especially should the market speak in his favour.
Got off the mark in taking fashion at Cork (19f) in early-May. Leap of faith required having gone off the rails since.

Maiden who was easy to back and shaped as if needing the run when well held at Bellewstown back in the spring. Could be worth chancing on return (went very close at this course 11 months ago). Engaged 4.30 Roscommon Mond
Pulled up sole start in points and possibly failed to stay the longer trip when well beaten at Listowel recently. Drops to 2m for this handicap debut and a first-time tongue tie goes on.
Fair maiden hurdler who has finished in the frame on all 4 starts this season, most recently when third of 10 on handicap debut at Downpatrick. Return to 2m looks a good move so he's shortlisted.

Much improved when making a successful handicap debut in 20-runner event at Cork (2m) in April. Ran to a similar level when runner-up at Ballinrobe in August but his jumping is beginning to look an issue.
Got off the mark in 2m maiden hurdle at Kilbeggan in June. Ran poorly on his next couple of starts but back on track with headgear discarded when third at Clonmel earlier in the month.
No show in maiden hurdles. Needs this switch to a handicap to bring out plenty of improvement.
Maiden who was out of form when last seen in the spring. Returns for a new yard but tough to warm to with the headgear discarded.

Long-standing maiden. Hasn't looked like capitalising on a falling mark in a trio of handicap hurdle starts for present yard this season (much shorter in the betting than previously at Gowran recently).
Well held all 3 starts in recent weeks and needs to show plenty more now handicapping.

races.name: Betting.Bet New Betting Sites Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: The step back up in trip clearly suited NO MORE BOLERO at Stratford last week and he finds himself on an unchanged mark here. He can follow up. Course winner Jackstell got back on the scoreboard last time and looks the likeliest danger.

runners.note: Completed quick hat-trick over hurdles this time last year and returned to form, following another breathing operation, when winning 8-runner handicap hurdle at Stratford (2¾m, good to firm, 15/2) 38 days ago. 4 lb rise

Veteran who ran right up to his best when runner-up at Worcester in May. Plugged on late to grab second at same course latest and is 2 lb lower now but he will likely have to settle for place money again.

Another success story for excellent yard, landing his fourth victory over hurdles when taking 4-runner handicap at Stratford (2¾m, good to firm) 8 days ago, pushed out. Escapes a penalty for that success and looks the on
Caused a surprise under an enterprising ride at Worcester in August but couldn't repeat that at Uttoxeter last month. Visor tried now but others are more appealing.

races.name: British EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict: This can go to WEDYAN, who should have learnt plenty from her encouraging Pontefract debut last month. Pivotal Voyage and Hoya Bella are also potential improvers and are feared most.

runners.note: Well supported and duly made a winning start in 13-runner maiden at Beverley (5f, heavy) 44 days ago. Must concede weight all round here but may have more to offer.
Yet to offer much in a couple of minor events.
Foaled January 29. A'ali filly. Dam unraced. Yard should prove best guide to claims on debut.
Bred for longer trips but posted encouraging third of 8 in novice (33/1) at Yarmouth (6f, good) on debut 27 days ago. Likely to build on that and must enter calculations.
Foaled March 11. 1,000 gns foal, Ubettabelieveit filly. Dam lightly-raced maiden. Trainer’s newcomers command respect.
Showed ability amidst inexperience when fourth of 10 in maiden (12/1) at Newcastle (6f) on debut 24 days ago, slowly away. Open to progress.
Fair filly who only narrowly failed to open her account in 8-runner maiden at Wolverhampton (6f) last week. One of likelier contenders.
Didn't progress from debut when seventh of 13 in novice at Carlisle (6f, good to soft) 34 days ago. Still early days but may need more time.

Foaled March 23. 11,000 gns yearling, Rajasinghe filly. Dam, winner up to 1m (2-y-o 6f/6.5f winner), half-sister to useful winner up to 1¼m (stays 1½m) Atherstone Warrior. Warrants respect on debut given connections.
Sent off big odds but showed ability when third of 13 in maiden at Beverley (5f, good, 66/1) on debut 27 days ago. More needed here but she is entitled to improve.
Promising individual who posted fair second of 8 in maiden at Pontefract (6f, good) on debut 19 days ago, nearest finish. Sets the standard on that form and is open to improvement.

races.name: Heb Group 'The Power Behind Everyday' Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Not much chasing form to go on here and JAMADA is taken to add to his bumper/hurdles victories and make a winning start in this sphere for the in-form Olly Murphy/Sean Bowen team. Lady Kara has chasing experience on her side and could emerge as the main danger if keeping the mistakes down.

runners.note: Point/hurdles winner on return last season. Pulled up in first-time cheekpieces on his handicap debut in the EBF Novices' Final at Sandown in March. Goes chasing down in trip on his reappearance with headgear quickly dis

Headstrong sort but firmly on the up over hurdles when last seen, signing off with an excellent third on his handicap debut at Chepstow (2m) in December. Off 9 months ahead of his chase debut but can't be discounted.
A fair 2m hurdles winner at his best but he ended last season under a cloud, tried in cheekpieces when well held at Haydock (2m) on his final run in April. Chasing debutant.

Bumper winner in Ireland. Got off the mark for current yard in 2m maiden hurdle at Fakenham in April and backed it up with a good third of 10 on handicap debut at Aintree (17f, good) in May when last seen. Should make hi

Won 2m handicap hurdle at Uttoxeter in June. Runner-up on 2m chasing debut at Market Rasen next time but below par all 3 runs since, only seventh back over fences in 2m Uttoxeter handicap 9 days ago. Could bounce back, a

Completed a hat-trick over hurdles at Newton Abbot (17f) in June. Yet to add to her tally over fences but runner-up in 2m Sedgefield handicaps last 2 starts. Can go well again off the same mark if keeping the mistakes do

races.name: William Hill Challenge Series Hurdle
races.verdict: The return to around 3m should suit SAMUI who may prove the answer to this trappy contest. Sandor Clegane isn't the easiest to win with but is still classy and has a decent record fresh so he might be the one to give Gordon Elliott's charge most to do.

runners.note: Seems no better than useful these days but he posted a decent effort when third in a similar race at Galway (2¾m, soft, 7/1) 36 days ago and won't need to raise his game much more to play a leading role here.

Useful winning hurdler/chaser at his best but has largely struggled since a Galway maiden chase success last summer. It remains to be seen whether a return to hurdling sparks an upturn in his fortunes.
Showed the benefit of a recent run on the level when second in a similar race at Down Royal (3m, good) in August. Not in quite the same form over shorter trips since but major player back around 3m.

Talented but ungenuine sort who took advantage of a good opportunity when gaining his first win since 2023 in a weak maiden chase at Down Royal in April. Respectable third in a novice chase at Killarney the following mon

Smart performer on his day who proved at least as good as ever when making all in a Grade 3 chase at Killarney in May. Three lesser runs have followed and now reverts to hurdles for the first time in 2 years in a bid to

races.name: Betting.Bet Play Champion Tipster Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: I LOVE YOU SIVOLA is thrown-in on his French form and has joined a yard amongst the winners. He could be worth chancing. Athena's Dream and Carrhill look the principal dangers.

runners.note: Nine-race maiden in Ireland who hasn't been seen for 4 years. Hard to know what to expect on debut for new yard here.
Just modest form at best over hurdles/fences for Chris Grant but won a couple of points earlier this year and is worth monitoring in the market on debut for new yard here.
Made the frame on several occasions in staying handicaps this year, latest when creditable third of 8 at Southwell (3m, good to firm) 12 days ago. Likely to be in the mix again.
Point winner but little promise over hurdles and fared no better in a couple of starts over fences earlier this year. Returns to smaller obstacles with plenty to prove.

Fair chaser at best in France back in 2022/23 but rarely threatened over hurdles/fences in Britain. However, he has plummeted down the handicap and is now in the care of Max Comley. Market check advised.
Merely hinted at ability in bumpers and over hurdles, no signs of improvement sent handicapping at Worcester 33 days ago. Now upped in trip with cheekpieces added.
Limited impact in 5 starts but not a bad sort physically and he's bred to be a lot better than this lowly mark. Perhaps this longer trip may see him in a better light.
Long-standing maiden with little solid form.

races.name: British EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict: NEW YEAR'S EVE has an appealing pedigree and will have learnt plenty from last month's Haydock debut. She is taken to get off the mark. Comrade Alexi looks the chief threat on form, whilst newcomers Velora and Lady Phillips are both much respected.

runners.note: Made appeal on paper and shaped quite well when fourth of 9 in novice at Kempton (1m, 5/1) on debut 20 days ago. Likely to improve.
Bred for stiffer tests and finished well held in novice at Newmarket (1m, good to firm) on debut 24 days ago. One for longer term.
Promising type who posted fair seventh of 10 in maiden at Ascot (1m, good, 18/1) on debut 39 days ago. Entitled to build on that.
Foaled March 25. Night of Thunder filly. Half-sister to useful 1¼m winner Venetia and 1¾m winner Word of Mouth. Dam winner up to 14.4f (2-y-o 8.3f winner). One to note on debut.
Held back by inexperience when fifth of 10 in novice at Haydock (7f, soft, 10/3) on debut 18 days ago. In good hands, however, and may well do better.
Went backwards from debut when well beaten in Goodwood maiden (1m) in August. Tried in headgear now but is likely best watched.
Foaled April 4. €395,000 yearling, Sea The Stars filly. Half-sister to several winners, including Prix de Diane winner Channel and French 9f winner Chennamma. Must be of interest on debut.

races.name: Case IH Drive Performance Drive Puma Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: THELASTHIGHKING clearly hasn't been the easiest to train given his infrequent appearances but the form of his Kempton fourth back in the spring is solid and resuming from a break with his yard having typically made a good start this autumn, this could be the time to catch him (gone well fresh). Move With The Beat is fancied to come on for his Fontwell reappearance 10 days ago and is the danger.

runners.note: 7-y-o who really got his act together over fences earlier this year, adding a fourth success to his tally at Newton Abbot (21f) in May. Looked rusty after 5 months off at Fontwell (19.5f) 10 days ago and good chance he'l

10-y-o who has been very lightly raced since landing back-to-back 2m handicap chases in 2023. Shaped as if retaining ability after 16 months off when fourth at Kempton (2¼m) in March (solid form) and likely he's been wel

Successful from 3 lb lower at Bangor (2½m) in March. Looked to be building up to something initially this summer before a less convincing display (slow away/jumped left at times) when fifth at Worcester (2½m) 18 days ago

Notched 2½m handicap chase double last summer. Began present campaign with 3 solid runner-up efforts at up to 23f before running an uncharacteristically flat race at Fontwell (19.5f) 3 weeks ago. Appeals as the type to b

Impressive all-the-way winner of a Worcester maiden hurdle on stable debut last summer and back in similar heart when making the frame in handicaps this season. Has yet to convince in 2 starts over fences in recent weeks
NON RUNNER.

races.name: William Hill Challenge Series Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: LIVE TO LAUGH's reappearance third at Listowel suggests he should have a race in him from his lower hurdle mark, particularly as the form has been franked by the fourth winning since. Warmer Days Ahead has had the form of his latest Kilbeggan success boosted on a few occasions and is second choice. Milan Forth and Labondance complete the shortlist.

runners.note: Course winner. Twelve runs since last win in 2024. Fifth of 7 in novice chase (4/1) at Ballinrobe (23f, good) 50 days ago. Switches from chase to hurdles. Cheekpieces on first time.
15/2, good second of 11 on belated handicap hurdle debut at Roscommon (3m, good to soft) 15 days ago, closing all way to line. Considered off 3 lb higher.
Winner at Navan in late 2024. Lightly raced and not added to that success since but entitled to be sharper for a recent comeback run at Gowran. Enters calculations.
Scored over hurdles at Cork in July. Creditable fourth of 14 in handicap hurdle at Gowran (2½m, good to soft) 11 days ago.
Fair maiden hurdler. 10/1, creditable seventh of 15 in handicap at Listowel (2½m, good to soft) 19 days ago.
Very much a mixed bag since ending a lengthy losing run in handicap chase at Kilbeggan in July. Others are preferred again.
Only win came in handicap hurdle at Downpatrick (2¾m) in April last year. Made an inauspicious start for new yard after leaving Gordon Elliott when pulled up over fences at Downpatrick 25 days ago.
C&D winner. Latest win in hurdle at Roscommon in September. 7/2, creditable fifth of 20 in handicap hurdle at Gowran (2½m, good to soft) 11 days ago. Looks competitive on form.

Fair form in France. Below that level when fourth in a pair of maiden hurdles for Emmet Mullins in recent months but may fare better now handicapping. All the more interesting if backed for last year's winning yard.

Blinkered and tongue tied first time, good fourth of 15 in handicap hurdle at Navan (21f, good to soft) 24 days ago, seeing it out well considering she was lit up in the headgear. Player if she can build on that.
Winner at Bellewstown (3m) in July. 11/1, bit below form when seventh of 13 over 2m at Navan 24 days ago but this trip is more suitable.
Sole success came in a weak Sligo maiden this time last year. Some respectable efforts in handicaps this season but faded into a below-par seventh at Listowel latest.
Reacted well to a visor (retained) to make a winning reappearance at Kilbeggan (19f, good to soft) last month. The form has been boosted so a 6 lb rise looks manageable.
C&D winner in June who added to his tally over 3m at Fairyhouse (good) 8 days ago. This veteran should remain competitive off 5 lb higher.
Fair maiden. 4/1, creditable fourth of 14 in handicap hurdle at Ballinrobe (2¾m, good) 32 days ago. Less exposed than the majority of these.
Eleven runs since last win in 2025. 14/1, bit below form when eighth of 13 in handicap hurdle at Gowran (2½m, good to soft) 11 days ago. Plenty to find on form.

Won twice over fences at up to 3m in March. Good third of 15 in handicap hurdle at Listowel (2m, good to soft) on reappearance 18 days ago. The fourth at Listowel has won since and he could have a big say back up in trip
Fifteen runs since last win in 2024. Creditable sixth of 20 in handicap at Gowran (2½m, good to soft, 14/1) 11 days ago, faring best of those held up.

races.name: Betting.Bet Free Bets Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: Preference is for SON OF HYPNOS, who bolted up under an attacking ride at Newton Abbot in August and Ryan Chapman's 9-y-o did a bit too much too soon attempting to replicate those tactics back there last month. The quirky Donnie Azoff won on this card 12 months ago and he can provide most resistance, with Krak also considered having his first start over hurdles for Dan Skelton.

runners.note: Winning hurdler in Ireland who is getting the hang of things over fences from an easing mark, finishing runner-up for the second start in a row at in 4-runner event at Bangor (17f, good) 5 weeks ago. Respected hurdling f

Veteran who has his quirks, but he's clearly been in fine heart since returning. Didn't jump well enough to be able to overhaul his one rival at Newton Abbot (2¼m, good to firm) in late-August but worth considering here.

Enjoyed a fine summer jumping campaign last year, winning 4 handicaps on the bounce at up to 2½m. Has also had a fruitful time on the Flat this summer, completing a quick-fire hat-trick at Nottingham (1¾m, good) in late-

Gone backwards following a positive start over fences last spring, but did run much better than on his reappearance back hurdling when third of 8 at Stratford (2¾m, good to firm) last month. Cheekpieces reapplied but not

Bumper winner who made a promising hurdling debut back in late-2024 for Gordon Elliott but went the wrong way. Proved some ability remains when fifth at Worcester in August but failed badly to build on that minor promise

Versatile performer in Ireland. Decisively capitalised on falling mark to open his account for current yard under an attacking ride at Newton Abbot (2¼m) in August but did too much too soon when sixth of 11 back there (1
Hasn't shown form for some time and returns for another new yard after over 2 years off the track. Can only be watched.

Was well supported returned to calmer waters but failed to live up to expectations when fourth of 8 in handicap hurdle at Fontwell (2¼m, good to soft) 10 days ago. Cheekpieces reapplied and not without each-way hope.

races.name: Join Racing TV Now Handicap
races.verdict: This is wide open. DASHING DICK rates just the pick of the weights on the back of a resurgent second here so edges the vote from Tiriac who hinted at a revival with a recent Nottingham fourth and rates a big threat. Irish Nectar, That's Random and Bay Breeze can all play a prominent role too in this highly competitive sprint.

runners.note: Successful on 2 of his 4 starts for this yard last season but it's hard to derive much encouragement from his 4 outings this year.
Completed a hat-trick (including over C&D) in early summer for Pam Sly. Good third of 7 for new yard in handicap back over C&D (good to firm) 7 days ago. Well in the mix.
Placed over 6f at Doncaster and Southwell in August. Run best ignored (got caught wide) when eleventh of 12 in handicap at Wolverhampton (7f) 25 days ago. Not dismissed.
Scored 3 times over 5f in 2025. Winless this season but not disgraced with fifth of 9 in handicap at Bath (5.7f, firm) 14 days ago. Needs considering from a falling mark.

Won twice over 5f at Newcastle last winter. Took a big step back in the right direction with fourth of 15 in handicap at Nottingham (6f, good) 12 days ago, finishing well having suffered a poor run from 2f out. Not witho
Opened his account in a 6f Windsor novice in May. Back to form in a first-time visor (retained) with second of 10 in handicap at Wolverhampton (6f) 11 days ago. Firmly in the picture.

Lightly-raced sort who was much improved on his handicap debut when landing 14-runner event at Doncaster (6f, good to firm) in June. Up 5 lb but likely capable of better still and a likely player after a break.
Winless this season and he arrives below par, retried in cheekpieces when fourth of 8 in handicap at Chester (6f, soft) in June. Others appeal more.
Bagged a 6f Chester novice last season. Mainly below par this season but not disgraced when sixth of 11 in handicap over C&D (good) last time. Needs to build on it.
Gained a first win at Southwell in April but lightly raced since and below form in 6f handicaps at Southwell and Newmarket on her last 2 runs.
Goes well on soft ground and bagged a pair of 6f handicaps at Hamilton last month. Up another 4 lb but not taken lightly in his hat-trick bid.
Twenty-one runs since last win in 2024 but comes here in good nick, fourth of 12 in handicap at Pontefract (6f, good to soft) 26 days ago. Should remain competitive.

Course winner. Signalled he is ready to strike again when second of 10 in handicap here (7f, good to firm) a week ago, helping set a strong pace and collared only late on. Expected to be bang there off an unchanged mark.
Eighteen runs since last win in 2024. Creditable third of 15 in handicap at Nottingham (6f, good) 12 days ago, nearest finish. Can make his presence felt.
Fair maiden. Went too freely when a below-par fourth of 7 in novice at Wolverhampton (6f) 11 days ago. Bounce back needed.
Doubled his tally at Thirsk (6f) in September. Didn't appear to handle bend when a below-form sixth of 10 in handicap at Wolverhampton (6f) 11 days ago. Can bounce back.
Fair maiden handicapper. Runner-up 3 times in a row earlier in the season but only ninth in first-time blinkers in handicap at Ayr (7f, heavy) 14 days ago. Needs to get back on track.
Got off the mark over 6f at Newmarket in June. Had usual cheekpieces left off when below-par fourth of 11 in handicap at Kempton (6f) 20 days ago. More is needed.

races.name: Case IH Dealer Network Top Class Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict: MELODYS ENCORE makes plenty of appeal on paper and has found a very winnable opening for her debut. There is a good chance she will be clued up enough to see off Masterius.

runners.note: Third to very promising Spanish Darling on second of 2 starts in point bumpers. Never landed a blow behind same rival in slowly-run bumper at Worcester last month.

Finished runner-up sole outing in Irish points and has made an encouraging start in bumpers at Market Rasen for all he failed to justify favouritism last time (still on the weak side). Obvious claims.

races.verdict: A few with chances but LAW OF DESIGN is fancied to build on recent promise and gain an overdue success off a handy-looking mark. Oviedo arrives in fine form and heads the list of dangers with Cypriot Diaspora and Francesi also in the mix.

Not the most straightforward but has landed a couple of 1m Carlisle handicaps this summer. Back to form with third of 9 in handicap at Redcar (1¼m, good to soft) 10 days ago. Considered.

Course winner who registered his first all-weather success at Lingfield in January. Well held at Nottingham and Yarmouth since, though, and needs to hit the ground running after 5 months off.
Quirky sort who scored at Musselburgh (7f) in June. Posted another good effort there when second of 10 in 7f handicap last month. Can't be dismissed.

races.verdict: DELULU laid down solid foundations in a pair of Worcester bumpers (arguably should have won on debut) and she makes plenty of appeal now her attentions are switched to hurdling by her top stable. Fakenham winner L'Amandine shaped like a stayer herself in that sphere and is interesting, whilst Masked Mistress remains with potential returned to hurdles.

races.verdict: POETIC FOCUS was only narrowly denied in a similar race at Clonmel earlier this month and remains feasibly treated. She can go one better here. Granlahan and Another Challenge head the list of dangers.

races.verdict: WINSTON'S OATH has upped his game since the visor went on, building on a good second when opening his account in clear-cut fashion back at Fontwell 10 days ago. Cork handicap hurdle winner last summer but hasn't seriously threatened to add to his tally this time round, finishing eighth of 16 at Killarney (17f, good to soft) 9 days ago.

races.name: Golf And Gallop Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: LUMINARIES races off the same mark as when successful at Kelso 9 days ago and, with the return to 3m firmly in his favour, he looks to have been found an excellent opportunity to follow up. East Eagle may emerge as the lead danger, with handicap debutant Trigger The Light another to monitor now his stamina is tested further.

runners.note: Runner-up in a point bumper before third in a Warwick bumper 12 months ago. Pulled up on hurdling debut but stepped up after break/breathing operation when third here (2½m) in June. Not in same form when fourth at Uttoxe

Bounced back to something like his best when a convincing winner at Stratford (3¼m, good to firm) in July. Didn't fare at all badly on back of a 6 lb rise when third at Sedgefield (27f) 5 weeks ago and possibilities for

races.name: Follow attheraces On Instagram Handicap
races.verdict: ROYAL COUNTY GLORY is on a roll and might be able to defy a penalty and stretch his winning run on all-weather to 4. Cosmic Clarets made a positive start for the Scott Dixon yard when runner-up over 6f here last month and can fill the forecast spot ahead of his former stablemate Supreme Dancer.

runners.note: On the up for new yard, making it 3 wins (all 7f, all-weather) when getting on top towards the finish at Kempton under Oisin Murphy 6 days ago. A 6-lb penalty shouldn't prevent another bold bid.
Off the mark at Kempton (1m) in January but has been summed up by her mark since. Billy Loughnane takes over the reins but others arrive with more compelling claims.
Fair maiden for Richard & Peter Fahey and ran up to best when second of 10 on 6f course yard debut 3 weeks ago. Player with a repeat.
Promise when placed in maidens (including C&D) on her first 3 starts but hasn't been able to continue the good work since handicapping. A return to tapeta needs to help spark a revival.
Runner-up twice this year prior to making it sixteenth time lucky in 7f Carlisle handicap (good to soft) under Ethan Tindall 8 weeks ago. Should remain competitive off 4 lb higher.
Remains winless and her last 2 efforts have been disappointing. Bounce back needed returned to all-weather.

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares Flat Race
races.verdict: JUNCTION ROAD has been the subject of a notable stable switch since her promising debut at Down Royal 7 weeks ago and she could make a winning start for Henry de Bromhead if building on that. Shuil Solas and Back In Favour are a couple of others who seem sure to be in the mix. Eastern Whisper is the most interesting newcomer.

runners.note: Point winner who has shown ability in bumpers, including over 2½m at Listowel last time when again finishing third (possibly paid to some extent for attempting to get on terms with the promising winner).
Much sharper second time up at Kilbeggan last month, albeit no match for winner who dominated (beaten 12 lengths in second). Likely to flourish at a later stage.
Shaped with a little encouragement on second run over hurdles at Navan last time but probably only playing for a place judged on her previous bumper form.
28,000 gns 3-y-o, Sea The Stars mare. Dam 11f/1½m winner in France. Jockey booking catches the eye and trainer doesn't do too bad in this sphere.
Court Cave mare. Half-sister to fairly useful hurdle winner Shabby Hill.
18/1, too free and well beaten in Tramore bumper in August. Hood goes on.

A blip at Wexford aside when shaping as if amiss she's made a promising start in bumpers, taking a step forward under this rider when 4 lengths second to another improver at Listowel last time. Might need a stiffer test
€1,000 3-y-o, Getaway filly. Sister to 2 winners, including bumper winner/fairly useful hurdler Benign Dictator. Cheap purchase but she's not without interest on breeding.
Walk In The Park filly. Dam, point winner, half-sister to fairly useful hurdler/fair chaser who became unreliable (winner around 2m) Joeswayornoway.

Beaten a long way in bumper here and Bellewstown juvenile hurdle last season.
Went with little encouragement when down the field in academy hurdle here 11 months ago for D Deacon.
Vendangeur filly. Half-sister to a point winner and fair hurdler Phils Choice, stays 23f. Dam (c104/h105) 2m hurdle winner (stayed 19f). Yard had a couple of bumper winners in August.
Tailed off in Listowel bumper on recent debut.

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: This looks a good opportunity for BELLA ANGELINA to make it third time lucky. Soft Landing went close on her C&D debut a fortnight ago and is second pick ahead of Oli Rix's new recruit Mr Keble.

runners.note: Looked a good prospect when making a winning start in 7-runner maiden (8/11) at Sligo (6f, good) for Paddy Twomey in May 2025 but not seen again a modest fifth at Newcastle (7f) for new yard 38 days ago. A watching brief
Blue Point half-brother to useful winner up to 7f Movie Maker. This is a slightly belated debut but he needs checking out in the betting.
Only minor promise in 2 outings for Charlie Johnston in the spring. Off 6 months. A watching is advised for new yard unless the betting suggests otherwise.
Showed promise in 2 outings for the Gosden stable last autumn. New stable acquired him for 10,000 gns in July. Has been gelded. Open to improvement.
4/1, offered something to work on when sixth of 8 in novice at Redcar (7f, good to soft) on debut 20 days ago. May do better.
It took a while to get her to the track but she showed some promise in 2 outings last month (C&D second occasion). Open to progress.
Has failed to beat a rival in a pair of 6f starts here in recent weeks.

Kingman filly who made an encouraging start to her career over the summer, third in a hood at Doncaster on debut and second to a useful sort (clear of the remainder) at Carlisle. Open to further progress back from a brea
Promising start to her career when head second of 10 in C&D maiden 14 days ago. Open to improvement with Oisin Murphy taking the ride.

races.name: Hotel & Conferencing At Wolverhampton Racecourse EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: MUHANDES remains capable of better and is narrowly preferred to Al Widyan, who had an excuse at Newbury last time and went close on all-weather at Kempton prior to that. Sea Palace may prove best of the rest.

runners.note: Stepped up on his Newmarket debut fourth when close third of 12 in novice at Kempton (6f) last month. Raced on the unfavoured part of the track at Newbury since and that run can be forgiven. Considered.
Stepped up on C&D debut when second of 9 over 5f here 11 days ago. Still looked green on that occasion so may have more to offer.
Gelded son of Too Darn Hot who was sent off at 33/1 when weakening to finish well held on 7f Kempton debut 4 weeks ago. Down in trip.

Foaled April 10. €85,000 Ten Sovereigns gelding. Half-brother to 2-y-o 6f winner Kokachin and 2-y-o 5f winner Under The Radar. Dam unraced half-sister to useful US 6f-1m winner Let's Meet In Rio. Check the betting with t
Big prices and well held both starts, merely passing beaten horses in a valuable sales race at Doncaster latterly.
Showcasing gelding who has shown promise on both 7f starts and remains open to improvement dropping to 6f.
Fair form. Cheekpieces on first time (retained), respectable fourth of 12 in nursery at Lingfield (6f, all-weather) 33 days ago. Likely to be on the premises.
Thirteenth of 15 in maiden (125/1) at Newbury (6f, good to firm) on debut 25 days ago, reportedly bled.
Has no form in 7 starts to date.

races.name: Stay At The Wolverhampton Holiday Inn Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict: ZACHARY HICKES rather stands out as an unexposed sort in this line-up, particularly at this trip, and is taken to build on his good third at Yarmouth last month. Oisin Murphy's mount Scarlet Moon is 3-3 on all-weather and is feared most ahead of Percy Jones.

Lightly-raced gelding who upped his game sent handicapping when winning 4-runner event at Yarmouth (11.5f, firm) in August. Good third of 10 over 1¾m back there latest. Makes tapeta debut. Remains unexposed for leading y

Not long with current yard and recorded first win for some time when taking 2m Musselburgh handicap in July. Well held there next time but bounced back with a hurdle win at Perth last month and a fair fourth at Market Ra
All 4 career victories here the latest over 1½m last summer. Largely creditable efforts in defeat this year, including when third at Bath on his last 2 outings. Likely to be on the premises again.
Wide-margin winner at Leicester (1½m) in July. Struggled on next 2 starts but back on the up with 1½m course win last month. Unseated leaving the stalls at Haydock since.

races.name: Cavani Champion Style Handicap
races.verdict: A tight-knit handicap in which marginal preference is for C&D scorer NEPTUNE LEGEND who has slipped in the weights and now has the services of Billy Loughnane. Far Too Fizzy could emerge as the chief threat with Oisin Murphy also an eye-catching booking, while On Key and Koffee And Kale can also have a say.

runners.note: Successful on all-weather over 5f at Newcastle and Lingfield in the spring. Ended his time with Richard Spencer with third placings here and at Windsor but only sixth of 8 for new connections over 5f here last time.
Fourteen runs since his last win in 2024 and hooded for first time when a below-form sixth of 14 in handicap at Southwell (1m) 17 days ago. Needs to bounce back.
Course winner. Signed off for Heather Main with below-form eighth of 10 in handicap at Salisbury (6f, good) 80 days ago. Not out of things if new yard sparks a resurgence.

Has done very well since rejoining this yard, winning 3 times during the summer. Not disgraced with fifth of 12 in handicap at Leicester (6f, good to firm) 22 days ago. This C&D scorer is a likely player off a 2 lb lower
Windsor 6f maiden winner for the Kubler's last summer. Good second of 9 in handicap at Goodwood (6f, heavy) on return for new yard but below par in 3 runs since. Makes tapeta debut.

Remains a maiden but runner-up over C&D in September. Possibly found run coming too soon when last of 11 in handicap at Lingfield (7f, all-weather) last time. Blinkers replace visor now and could bounce back.
Gained a first win at Newcastle (5f) in June but has failed to kick on, only twelfth of 14 over 6f there last month. Needs to take a step forward.

Lingfield 6f all-weather scorer in January. Made the frame several times since but never able to land a blow after a slow start when seventh of 10 in handicap over C&D 11 days ago. Can't be discounted with Oisin Murphy b

Scored at Leicester on stable debut last summer. However, ended the season out of form and little encouragement thus far this time around.
Course winner but largely below par in 2026, coming in twelfth of 13 in handicap at Southwell (6f) 26 days ago. Lots more is required.
Gained a deserved first success over 7f here in July. Has continued in good heart, short of room home turn when fourth of 10 in handicap at Lingfield (7f, all-weather) last time. Considered.
Scored over 5f here in February for Martin Dunne. Has failed to go on since an encouraging debut for present yard, tried in a hood when seventh of 11 at Kempton (6f) last time.

races.name: Race & Rest - Wolverhampton Holiday Inn Handicap
races.verdict: SNAAFY rates the clear pick of the weights off the same mark as when a resurgent third at Leicester a week ago so looks the way to go here. Coxy's Star is next on the list on the back of her recent C&D second, while Aurelune and Gifts Differing also need factoring in.

runners.note: Fair maiden but proved rather expensive to follow. Signed off for Jack Jones with a well-held fourth over hurdles at Newton Abbot last month. Visor goes on for first time for new yard.
Behind all 3 runs over 7f, coming in last of 10 in maiden here 14 days ago. Goes up in trip for his handicap debut with significantly more required.

Landed 1m Hamilton maiden last autumn. Has beaten one rival in her last 3 runs, last of 7 at Doncaster (1m, firm) in July. Has since had a breathing operation and first-time tongue strap also fitted for tapeta debut.
Remains a maiden and he has been below par in 7f handicaps at Redcar and Ayr on his last 2 runs since returning from 5 months off.
Has improved since switched to handicaps when placed over 1m at Leicester and Hamilton. Must enter calculations off an unchanged mark.
Back to form with second of 12 in handicap over C&D 15 days ago. Very much one to consider off the same mark in her bid for a breakthrough success.

Scored over C&D in December. Returned to form in first-time cheekpieces when third of 10 in handicap at Leicester (7f, good to firm) a week ago, despite going off too hard. Blinkers go on for first time now. Weighted to
A fair 7f scorer (albeit not straightforward) for Hugo Palmer who signed off for that yard with a good third at Wetherby in June. Not in same form in 3 starts for this stable, though.
Shaped well when runner-up at Newcastle for her new yard in September but only tenth of 11 in handicap here (9.5f) 22 days ago. Not out of it if back on her A-game.
Is 0-8 and she came in last of 11 in handicap at Kempton (1m) 13 days ago. Tongue strap goes on for first time.
Unreliable maiden for James Horton. Yet to hit top form in 3 runs for new handler, sixth of 10 over C&D 22 days ago. Visor is retried now.
Well held in novices and in handicaps at Salisbury (1m) and Sandown (1¼m, good to soft) on her last 2 runs.
Showed ability in maidens in Ireland last year but hasn't fired in 6 starts for current yard this season.

races.name: Cavani Raceday Style Handicap
races.verdict: MIDNIGHT MEDIA rates the pick of the weights and is fancied to gain a third success of the season. Currumbin seems sure to go well too but could have to settle for runner-up spot once more ahead of Pipily and Bradbury.

runners.note: Thirteen runs since last win in 2025 but he is knocking on the door, second for the fourth start running in handicap at Kempton (1½m) 8 days ago when conceding first run. Tongue strap goes on for first time and set to go
Well backed and gained a first win for current yard at Bath (11.5f) in July. However, well held next 3 starts, including when retried in cheekpieces.
Good third in 7f Catterick maiden last August. Below par in 3 handicaps since, tried hooded when seventh of 11 in handicap here (9.5f) 15 days ago. Tried over a much longer trip here.

Not straightforward but recorded 1¼m wins at Leicester and Wetherby in June and gained a third success at Hamilton (9f, soft) in September. Below-par sixth of 9 at Redcar (1¼m, good to soft) 10 days ago but can't be rule

Thriving this summer and scored twice over 1¼m here and at Nottingham. Shaped well when twice runner-up since here and badly hampered 1f out when fourth of 12 at Southwell (11f) 19 days ago. Remains one to be interested
In good form without winning, not best drawn when fifth of 11 in handicap here (9.5f) 15 days ago. Not ruled out stepping up in trip.
On a long losing run and he ended his time with Tony Carroll with a below-par seventh of 9 in handicap at Chepstow (1¼m, good to firm) in July. Needs this yard switch to spark a resurgence.

Benefited from a good ride when ending losing run in classified event at Lingfield (1½m, all-weather) in August for Pat Phelan. Posted a good third of 9 on yard debut in handicap at Brighton (1½m, good) week ago. In the

Finally opened her account at Nottingham in June and quickly doubled her tally back there (1¼m) in July. Posted a solid fourth of 6 in classified event at Yarmouth (11.5f, good) last time. Not out of things after a break
Quirky maiden who failed to back up a good C&D third when seventh of 9 in handicap at Brighton (1½m, good) week ago. Others appeal more.
Well held on all her 3 runs, tried in cheekpieces when last of 6 in maiden here (9.5f) in August. Blinkers go on for her handicap debut with plenty more required.
